def solve(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    R=[r for r in range(H) if any(x not in (1,9) for x in g[r])]
    C=[c for c in range(W) if any(g[r][c] not in (1,9) for r in range(H))]
    out=[]
    for i in range(len(R)-1):
        row=[]
        for j in range(len(C)-1):
            cs=[g[R[i+k]][C[j+l]] for k in (0,1) for l in (0,1)]
            v=cs[0] if len(set(cs))==1 and cs[0]!=1 else 9
            row.append(v)
        out.append(row)
    return out

# Solid-separator-lines model. Line color = color of full-width rows (or full-height cols) that are NOT region background.
def detect_line(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    best=None
    for v,_ in collections.Counter(x for row in g for x in row).items():
        s=sum(sum(x==v for x in row)==W for row in g)+sum(sum(row[c]==v for c in range(W))==H for row in g)
        if best is None or s>best[1]: best=(v,s)
    return best
def f(g,outbg=9):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    lr,_=detect_line(g)

    rest=[v for v,c in cnt.items() if v!=lr]

    mr=[r for r in range(H) if sum(x!=lr for x in g[r])>=1]

# Hypothesis: separator color X = color of full-length runs (rows/cols almost entirely X).
# Output dims = (#marker rows-1) x (#marker cols-1); cell = corner color if all four corners equal, else bg(fill color).
def f(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=collections.Counter(x for row in g for x in row)
    # separator color: color with longest maximal contiguous run in any row or col
    def run_len(v,grid,axis,indices,n):
        best=0
        for s in indices:
            l=0
            while s+l<n and grid[s+l]==v: l+=1
            best=max(best,l)
        return best
    cand=[]
    for v,_ in cnt.items():
        cand.append((run_len(v,g,0,range(H),W)+run_len(v,g,1,range(W),H),v))
    cand.sort(reverse=True)
    sep=cand[0][1]
    # region fill = most frequent color excluding separator
    rest={v:c for v,c in cnt.items() if v!=sep}
    bg=max(rest,key=lambda v:rest[v])
    mrr=[r for r in range(H) if any(g[r][c]!=bg for c in range(W))]
    mcc=[c for c in range(W) if any(g[r][c]!=bg for r in range(H))]

            rr.append(vals.pop() if len(vals)==1 else bg)

    return res
